name: Kadane's Algorithm
description: Kadane's algorithm finds the maximum sum of a contiguous subarray in O(N) time. It is a classic example of a space-optimized DP where the state is simply 'the best subarray ending at the current index'.
approach: Maintain current_max = max(nums[i], current_max + nums[i]) and overall best = max(best, current_max). A negative running sum is discarded by restarting from the current element.
use_cases: Variants like maximum product subarray, maximum circular subarray.
Best time to buy/sell stock framing.
common_mistakes: Forgetting to compare the running sum against the element itself.
Initializing the answer to 0 when all numbers are negative.
related_problems: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
